body.title: Daemon replies carry completeness
body.summary: repo.list, repo.stats and daemon.status (src/daemon/index.ts, src/daemon/repo-stats.ts, src/daemon/status.ts) return completeness: RepoCompleteness beside the unchanged four-value status; DaemonStatus gains unattributedUnwritable; the types in src/shared/types.ts. Anchors: repo.list (src/daemon/index.ts:580-582), repo.stats (:589-599, collectRepoStats in src/daemon/repo-stats.ts:122) and daemon.status (:1043-1066, src/daemon/status.ts:49-75); the status union is at src/shared/types.ts:696. Depends on t2 for completenessOf.
acceptanceChecks: Each reply carries completeness for an incomplete and a complete repository, with status unchanged
Existing repo-stats and daemon-status contract tests pass unchanged apart from the added field

tests.name: src/daemon/__tests__/repo-completeness.test.ts: repo.list, repo.stats and daemon.status carry completeness beside the unchanged status; unattributedUnwritable
